sources.label: RA 9514: Fire Code of the Philippines — Security and Access Control
sources.description: Governs access control systems in relation to fire safety: egress path locking requirements, panic hardware, and fail-safe vs. fail-secure door operation.

sources.label: BP 344: Accessibility Law — Accessible Door Hardware and Security
sources.description: Specifies accessible door hardware requirements and access control considerations for persons with disabilities.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule VIII — Means of Egress: Locking and Security
sources.description: Governs permissible locking arrangements on egress doors. Requires panic hardware for Group B/C/D/F occupancies with occupant load >=50.
